go_min_criteria: prefer fewer active claims when equivalent information gain is available
archive superseded branches but retain negative receipts

m_minus_rules: anti-repeat: do not regenerate exact semantic duplicate

anti-replication: no replication label without independent evidence

promotion_rules: verified promotion requires evidence receipt + baseline + falsifier + provenance

stopping_rules: HOLD if no positive expected-information-gain or deliberate stress-test hypothesis
HOLD scientific promotion if baseline/evidence/novelty/OAK gates incomplete
GO MIN if marginal frontier novelty collapses or duplicate rate rises above 0.25
